2124519838303527314.en_summary: $NYMO is the NYSE McClellan Oscillator, a market breadth momentum indicator. Extreme readings near -88/-90 (or similar deep negatives) are a classic “oversold breadth” condition that has often coincided with or preceded market bottoms and strong bounces.
2124519838303527314.zh_summary: $NYMO是紐約證券交易所McClellan振盪器，一種市場廣度動能指標。接近-88/-90（或類似深度負值）的極端讀數是經典的「超賣廣度」條件，經常與市場底部和強勁反彈同時或之前出現。

2124518637478314437.en_summary: $IREN counterpoints to bear post. $30B CapEx was prior higher guidance already cut. Current planning around $15B, with ~$9B identified from cash, facilities, prepayments and ~$6B still targeted. Fully owned vertical model allows pacing growth respecting credit market. Fully funded from $1B ARR now to over $4B ARR by Jan/Feb, then $10B unencumbered assets to borrow against and prepayments to bridge $6B gap without ATM/dilution. Material portion of $20B backlog with investment-grade counterparties. Vertical model highest AI Cloud gross margins once prepayments credited. Financing the question. If achieves Nvidia exemplar cloud status again for remaining tranches by Jan/Feb, chance to prove financing without dilution, flywheel test. If delivers, stock chance to reach new highs in 2027. NFA.
2124518637478314437.zh_summary: $IREN對空頭帖文的反駁。300億美元資本支出是先前較高指引已被削減。當前規劃約150億美元，約90億已從現金、設施、預付款識別，約60億仍目標。全擁有垂直模型允許以尊重信貸市場的方式調整增長。從現在10億ARR完全資助到1月/2月超過40億ARR，然後有100億無負擔資產可借款，以及預付款填補60億缺口，無需ATM和更多稀釋。200億積壓的重要部分與投資級對手方。一旦預付款計入，垂直模型產生最高AI雲毛利率。融資是問題。如果在1月/2月再次實現Nvidia典範雲狀態，有機會證明無需稀釋的融資，飛輪測試。如果實現，股票有機會在2027年達到新高。非投資建議。
